name: InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem vagnerMap_apply (a x : S) : vagnerMap a x = x * a
proof: := rfl

name: InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem vagnerMap_source (a : S) :
    (vagnerMap a).source = {x | x * (a * a⁻¹) = x}
proof: := rfl

name: InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem vagnerMap_target (a : S) :
    (vagnerMap a).target = {y | y * (a⁻¹ * a) = y}
proof: := rfl

name: InverseSemigroup.mem_vagnerMap_source_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vagnerMap_source_iff (a x : S) :
    x ∈ (vagnerMap a).source ↔ ∃ s : S, x = s * (a * a⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hx => ⟨x, hx.symm⟩, fun ⟨s, hs⟩ => by
    change x * (a * a⁻¹) = x
    have : IsIdempotentElem (a * a⁻¹) := isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a
    rw [hs, mul_assoc, this.eq]⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_trans
statement:
theorem vagnerMap_trans (a b : S) :
    vagnerMap (a * b) = (vagnerMap a).trans (vagnerMap b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : b * (b⁻¹ * (a⁻¹ * a)) = a⁻¹ * (a * (b * b⁻¹)) := by
    have h := idempotent_mul_comm (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b) (isIdempotentElem_inv_mul a)
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  have haa : ∀ z : S, a * (a⁻¹ * (a * z)) = a * z := fun z => by
    have h := congrArg (· * z) (mul_inv_mul a)
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  refine PartialEquiv.ext (fun x => (mul_assoc x a b).symm) (fun x => ?_) ?_
  · 
    change x * (a * b)⁻¹ = x * b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
    rw [mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc]
  · 
    rw [PartialEquiv.trans_source]
    ext x
    simp only [vagnerMap_source, vagnerMap_apply, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
      Set.mem_setOf_eq, mul_inv_rev]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      simp only [mul_assoc] at hx
      
      have h2 : x * a * (b * b⁻¹) = x * a := by
        have h := congrArg (· * a) hx
        simp only [mul_assoc] at h
        rw [hcomm, haa] at h
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
      refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
      have h := congrArg (· * a⁻¹) h2
      simp only [mul_assoc] at h
      
      exact h.symm.trans hx
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have h := congrArg (· * a⁻¹) h2
      simp only [mul_assoc] at h ⊢
      
      rw [h]
      exact h1

name: InverseSemigroup.vagnerMap_injective
statement:
theorem vagnerMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (vagnerMap : S → PartialEquiv S S)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have happ : ∀ x : S, x * a = x * b := fun x =>
    congrArg (fun e : PartialEquiv S S => e x) h
  have hsrc : {x : S | x * (a * a⁻¹) = x} = {x : S | x * (b * b⁻¹) = x} :=
    congrArg PartialEquiv.source h
  have h1 : (a * a⁻¹) * (b * b⁻¹) = a * a⁻¹ := by
    have hmem : a * a⁻¹ ∈ {x : S | x * (a * a⁻¹) = x} := (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a).eq
    rw [hsrc] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have h2 : (b * b⁻¹) * (a * a⁻¹) = b * b⁻¹ := by
    have hmem : b * b⁻¹ ∈ {x : S | x * (b * b⁻¹) = x} := (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b).eq
    rw [← hsrc] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hee : a * a⁻¹ = b * b⁻¹ :=
    calc a * a⁻¹ = (a * a⁻¹) * (b * b⁻¹) := h1.symm
      _ = (b * b⁻¹) * (a * a⁻¹) :=
          idempotent_mul_comm (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a) (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b)
      _ = b * b⁻¹ := h2
  calc a = a * a⁻¹ * a := (mul_inv_mul a).symm
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * a := by rw [hee]
    _ = b * (b⁻¹ * a) := mul_assoc b b⁻¹ a
    _ = b * (b⁻¹ * b) := by rw [happ b⁻¹]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * b := (mul_assoc b b⁻¹ b).symm
    _ = b := mul_inv_mul b

name: InverseSemigroup.vagner_preston
statement:
theorem vagner_preston :
    ∃ θ : S → PartialEquiv S S,
      Function.Injective θ ∧ ∀ a b : S, θ (a * b) = (θ a).trans (θ b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨vagnerMap, vagnerMap_injective, vagnerMap_trans⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.eq_idem_mul_aux
statement:
private theorem eq_idem_mul_aux {a b e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (hae : a = e * b) :
    a = a * a⁻¹ * b
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : a⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * e := by rw [hae, mul_inv_rev, inv_idem he]
  rw [hinv, hae]
  calc e * b
      = e * e * (b * b⁻¹ * b) := by rw [he.eq, mul_inv_mul]
    _ = e * (e * (b * b⁻¹)) * b := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = e * (b * b⁻¹ * e) * b := by rw [idempotent_mul_comm he (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b)]
    _ = e * b * (b⁻¹ * e) * b := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: InverseSemigroup.eq_mul_inv_mul_aux
statement:
private theorem eq_mul_inv_mul_aux {a b : S} (hab : a = a * a⁻¹ * b) :
    a = b * (a⁻¹ * a)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : a⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hab]
    rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_idem (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a)]
  have hcomm := idempotent_mul_comm (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b) (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a)
  symm
  calc b * (a⁻¹ * a)
      = b * (b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) * a) := by conv_lhs => rw [hinv]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹ * a) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * a := by rw [mul_inv_mul]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹ * b) := by conv_lhs => rw [hab]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) * b := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = a * a⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹) * b := by rw [hcomm]
    _ = a * a⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹ * b) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = a * a⁻¹ * b := by rw [mul_inv_mul]
    _ = a := hab.symm

name: InverseSemigroup.le_trans_aux
statement:
private theorem le_trans_aux {a b c : S} (hab : a = a * a⁻¹ * b) (hbc : b = b * b⁻¹ * c) :
    a = a * a⁻¹ * c
proof:
:= by
  have he : IsIdempotentElem (a * a⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹)) :=
    isIdempotentElem_mul (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a) (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b)
  refine eq_idem_mul_aux he ?_
  calc a = a * a⁻¹ * b := hab
    _ = a * a⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹ * c) := by rw [← hbc]
    _ = a * a⁻¹ * (b * b⁻¹) * c := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: InverseSemigroup.le_antisymm_aux
statement:
private theorem le_antisymm_aux {a b : S} (hab : a = a * a⁻¹ * b) (hba : b = b * b⁻¹ * a) :
    a = b
proof:
:=
  calc a = b * (a⁻¹ * a) := eq_mul_inv_mul_aux hab
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * a * (a⁻¹ * a) := by conv_lhs => rw [hba]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹ * a) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * a := by rw [mul_inv_mul]
    _ = b := hba.symm

name: InverseSemigroup.le_def
statement: theorem le_def {a b : S} : a ≤ b ↔ a = a * a⁻¹ * b
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: InverseSemigroup.le_iff_exists_idem_mul
statement:
theorem le_iff_exists_idem_mul {a b : S} :
    a ≤ b ↔ ∃ e : S, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ a = e * b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨a * a⁻¹, isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a, le_def.mp h⟩,
   fun ⟨_, he, hae⟩ => le_def.mpr (eq_idem_mul_aux he hae)⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le
statement: theorem eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) : a = b * (a⁻¹ * a)
proof:
:=
  eq_mul_inv_mul_aux (le_def.mp h)

name: InverseSemigroup.le_of_eq_mul_idem
statement:
theorem le_of_eq_mul_idem {a b f : S} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hab : a = b * f) :
    a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_exists_idem_mul]
  refine ⟨b * (f * b⁻¹), by simpa only [inv_inv] using isIdempotentElem_conj hf b⁻¹, ?_⟩
  have hcomm := idempotent_mul_comm hf (isIdempotentElem_inv_mul b)
  calc a = b * f := hab
    _ = b * b⁻¹ * b * f := by rw [mul_inv_mul]
    _ = b * (b⁻¹ * b * f) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = b * (f * (b⁻¹ * b)) := by rw [← hcomm]
    _ = b * (f * b⁻¹) * b := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: InverseSemigroup.le_iff_eq_mul_inv_mul
statement: theorem le_iff_eq_mul_inv_mul {a b : S} : a ≤ b ↔ a = b * (a⁻¹ * a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le, le_of_eq_mul_idem (isIdempotentElem_inv_mul a)⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.le_iff_exists_mul_idem
statement:
theorem le_iff_exists_mul_idem {a b : S} :
    a ≤ b ↔ ∃ f : S, IsIdempotentElem f ∧ a = b * f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨a⁻¹ * a, isIdempotentElem_inv_mul a, eq_mul_inv_mul_of_le h⟩,
   fun ⟨_, hf, hab⟩ => le_of_eq_mul_idem hf hab⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv
statement: protected theorem inv_le_inv {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) : a⁻¹ ≤ b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hae⟩ := le_iff_exists_idem_mul.mp h
  exact le_of_eq_mul_idem he (by rw [hae, mul_inv_rev, inv_idem he])

name: InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv_iff
statement: @[simp] protected theorem inv_le_inv_iff {a b : S} : a⁻¹ ≤ b⁻¹ ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [inv_inv] using InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv h,
   InverseSemigroup.inv_le_inv⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.mul_le_mul
statement:
protected theorem mul_le_mul {a b c d : S} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    a * c ≤ b * d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hae⟩ := le_iff_exists_idem_mul.mp hab
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hcf⟩ := le_iff_exists_idem_mul.mp hcd
  have hcomm := idempotent_mul_comm hf (isIdempotentElem_inv_mul b)
  refine le_iff_exists_idem_mul.mpr ⟨e * (b * (f * b⁻¹)),
    isIdempotentElem_mul he (by simpa only [inv_inv] using isIdempotentElem_conj hf b⁻¹), ?_⟩
  symm
  calc e * (b * (f * b⁻¹)) * (b * d)
      = e * (b * (f * (b⁻¹ * b)) * d) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = e * (b * (b⁻¹ * b * f) * d) := by rw [hcomm]
    _ = e * (b * b⁻¹ * b * (f * d)) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = e * (b * (f * d)) := by rw [mul_inv_mul]
    _ = a * c := by rw [hae, hcf, mul_assoc]

name: InverseSemigroup.le_iff_eq_mul
statement: theorem le_iff_eq_mul {e b : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e ≤ b ↔ e = e * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def, inv_idem he, he.eq]

name: InverseSemigroup.mul_le_left
statement: theorem mul_le_left {a f : S} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : a * f ≤ a
proof:
:=
  le_of_eq_mul_idem hf rfl

name: InverseSemigroup.mul_le_right
statement: theorem mul_le_right {e b : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e * b ≤ b
proof:
:=
  le_iff_exists_idem_mul.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.inv_inv
statement: @[simp] theorem inv_inv (a : S) : a⁻¹⁻¹ = a
proof:
:=
  (inv_unique (inv_mul_inv a) (mul_inv_mul a)).symm

name: InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_mul_inv
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_mul_inv (a : S) : IsIdempotentElem (a * a⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  show a * a⁻¹ * (a * a⁻¹) = a * a⁻¹ by
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_mul]

name: InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_inv_mul
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_inv_mul (a : S) : IsIdempotentElem (a⁻¹ * a)
proof:
:=
  show a⁻¹ * a * (a⁻¹ * a) = a⁻¹ * a by
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_inv]

name: InverseSemigroup.inv_idem
statement: theorem inv_idem {e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : e⁻¹ = e
proof:
:= by
  have h : e * e * e = e := by rw [he.eq, he.eq]
  exact (inv_unique h h).symm

name: InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_mul
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_mul {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : IsIdempotentElem (e * f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : S, x = (e * f)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he2 : ∀ z : S, e * (e * z) = e * z := fun z => by rw [← mul_assoc, he.eq]
  have hf2 : ∀ z : S, f * (f * z) = f * z := fun z => by rw [← mul_assoc, hf.eq]
  have hx1 : (e * f) * x * (e * f) = e * f := by rw [hx]; exact mul_inv_mul (e * f)
  have hx2 : ∀ z : S, x * (e * (f * (x * z))) = x * z := fun z => by
    have h := congrArg (· * z) (inv_mul_inv (e * f))
    rw [← hx] at h
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
  
  have hA : (e * f) * (f * x * e) * (e * f) = e * f := by
    have h := hx1
    simp only [mul_assoc] at h ⊢
    rw [hf2, he2]
    exact h
  have hB : (f * x * e) * (e * f) * (f * x * e) = f * x * e := by
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [he2, hf2, hx2]
  
  have hxeq : f * x * e = x := (inv_unique hA hB).trans hx.symm
  have hxx : IsIdempotentElem x := by
    have h : (f * x * e) * (f * x * e) = f * x * e := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      rw [hx2]
    rw [hxeq] at h
    exact h
  
  have hef : e * f = x := by
    have h := inv_idem hxx
    rw [hx, inv_inv] at h
    rw [hx]
    exact h
  rw [hef]
  exact hxx

name: InverseSemigroup.idempotent_mul_comm
statement:
theorem idempotent_mul_comm {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) : e * f = f * e
proof:
:= by
  have hef := isIdempotentElem_mul he hf
  have hfe := isIdempotentElem_mul hf he
  have he2 : ∀ z : S, e * (e * z) = e * z := fun z => by rw [← mul_assoc, he.eq]
  have hf2 : ∀ z : S, f * (f * z) = f * z := fun z => by rw [← mul_assoc, hf.eq]
  have hA : (e * f) * (f * e) * (e * f) = e * f := by
    have h := hef.eq
    simp only [mul_assoc] at h ⊢
    rw [hf2, he2]
    exact h
  have hB : (f * e) * (e * f) * (f * e) = f * e := by
    have h := hfe.eq
    simp only [mul_assoc] at h ⊢
    rw [he2, hf2]
    exact h
  exact ((inv_unique hA hB).trans (inv_idem hef)).symm

name: InverseSemigroup.mul_inv_rev
statement: theorem mul_inv_rev (a b : S) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := idempotent_mul_comm (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv b) (isIdempotentElem_inv_mul a)
  have h1 : (a * b) * (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b) = a * b :=
    calc (a * b) * (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b)
        = a * ((b * b⁻¹) * (a⁻¹ * a)) * b := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = a * ((a⁻¹ * a) * (b * b⁻¹)) * b := by rw [hcomm]
      _ = (a * a⁻¹ * a) * (b * b⁻¹ * b) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = a * b := by rw [mul_inv_mul, mul_inv_mul]
  have h2 : (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b) * (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ :=
    calc (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b) * (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹)
        = b⁻¹ * ((a⁻¹ * a) * (b * b⁻¹)) * a⁻¹ := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = b⁻¹ * ((b * b⁻¹) * (a⁻¹ * a)) * a⁻¹ := by rw [← hcomm]
      _ = (b⁻¹ * b * b⁻¹) * (a⁻¹ * a * a⁻¹) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by rw [inv_mul_inv, inv_mul_inv]
  exact (inv_unique h1 h2).symm

name: InverseSemigroup.isIdempotentElem_conj
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_conj {e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (a : S) :
    IsIdempotentElem (a⁻¹ * (e * a))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := idempotent_mul_comm (isIdempotentElem_mul_inv a) he
  change (a⁻¹ * (e * a)) * (a⁻¹ * (e * a)) = a⁻¹ * (e * a)
  calc (a⁻¹ * (e * a)) * (a⁻¹ * (e * a))
      = a⁻¹ * (e * (a * a⁻¹) * e) * a := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = a⁻¹ * ((a * a⁻¹) * e * e) * a := by rw [← hcomm]
    _ = a⁻¹ * ((a * a⁻¹) * (e * e)) * a := by rw [mul_assoc (a * a⁻¹) e e]
    _ = a⁻¹ * ((a * a⁻¹) * e) * a := by rw [he.eq]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (e * (a * a⁻¹)) * a := by rw [hcomm]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (e * (a * a⁻¹ * a)) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = a⁻¹ * (e * a) := by rw [mul_inv_mul]

name: InverseSemigroup.isInverseOf_inv
statement: theorem isInverseOf_inv : IsInverseOf a⁻¹ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨mul_inv_mul a, inv_mul_inv a⟩

name: InverseSemigroup.isRegularElem
statement: theorem isRegularElem : IsRegularElem a
proof:
:=
  ⟨a⁻¹, mul_inv_mul a⟩

name: mem_principalIdealSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_principalIdealSet {a b : S} :
    a ∈ principalIdealSet b ↔ a ≤𝓙 b
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_principalIdealSet_self
statement: theorem mem_principalIdealSet_self (a : S) : a ∈ principalIdealSet a
proof:
:=
  IsGreenJRel.of_eq rfl

name: IsGreenJRel.mul_left_closed
statement:
theorem IsGreenJRel.mul_left_closed {x a : S} (h : x ≤𝓙 a) (s : S) :
    s * x ≤𝓙 a
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | of_eq h => exact .mul_left s (by rw [h])
  | mul_left u h => exact .mul_left (s * u) (by rw [h, mul_assoc])
  | mul_right v h => exact .mul_both s v (by rw [h, mul_assoc])
  | mul_both u v h => exact .mul_both (s * u) v (by rw [h]; simp only [mul_assoc])

name: IsGreenJRel.mul_right_closed
statement:
theorem IsGreenJRel.mul_right_closed {x a : S} (h : x ≤𝓙 a) (s : S) :
    x * s ≤𝓙 a
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | of_eq h => exact .mul_right s (by rw [h])
  | mul_left u h => exact .mul_both u s (by rw [h])
  | mul_right v h => exact .mul_right (v * s) (by rw [h, mul_assoc])
  | mul_both u v h => exact .mul_both u (v * s) (by rw [h, mul_assoc])

name: isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet
statement:
theorem isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet (a : S) :
    IsSemigroupIdeal (principalIdealSet a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨a, mem_principalIdealSet_self a⟩,
   fun _ hx s => ⟨hx.mul_left_closed s, hx.mul_right_closed s⟩⟩

name: IsSemigroupIdeal.principalIdealSet_subset
statement:
theorem IsSemigroupIdeal.principalIdealSet_subset {T : Set S} (hT : IsSemigroupIdeal T)
    {x : S} (hx : x ∈ T) : principalIdealSet x ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  rintro y (rfl | ⟨u, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, v, rfl⟩)
  · exact hx
  · exact (hT.2 x hx u).1
  · exact (hT.2 x hx v).2
  · exact (hT.2 _ (hT.2 x hx u).1 v).2

name: isLeast_principalIdealSet
statement:
theorem isLeast_principalIdealSet (a : S) :
    IsLeast {T : Set S | IsSemigroupIdeal T ∧ a ∈ T} (principalIdealSet a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet a, mem_principalIdealSet_self a⟩,
   fun _ hT => hT.1.principalIdealSet_subset hT.2⟩

name: isGreenJ_iff_principalIdealSet_eq
statement:
theorem isGreenJ_iff_principalIdealSet_eq {a b : S} :
    principalIdealSet a = principalIdealSet b ↔ a 𝓙 b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := mem_principalIdealSet_self a; rw [h] at this; exact this
    · have := mem_principalIdealSet_self b; rw [← h] at this; exact this
  · intro h
    exact Set.Subset.antisymm
      ((isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet b).principalIdealSet_subset h.1)
      ((isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet a).principalIdealSet_subset h.2)

name: IsGreenJRel.principalIdealSet_subset
statement:
theorem IsGreenJRel.principalIdealSet_subset {a b : S} (h : a ≤𝓙 b) :
    principalIdealSet a ⊆ principalIdealSet b
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => IsGreenJRel.trans hx h

name: IsZeroSimple.exists_ne_zero
statement: theorem IsZeroSimple.exists_ne_zero (hS : IsZeroSimple S) : ∃ a : S, a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hS.exists_mul_ne_zero
  exact ⟨a, fun h => hab (by rw [h, zero_mul])⟩

name: IsZeroSimple.isGreenJRel_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsZeroSimple.isGreenJRel_of_ne_zero (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : S) : b ≤𝓙 a
proof:
:= by
  rcases hS.ideal_eq_bot_or_top _ (isSemigroupIdeal_principalIdealSet a) with h | h
  · have hmem := mem_principalIdealSet_self a
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact absurd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem) ha
  · exact Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp h b

name: IsZeroSimple.isGreenJ_of_ne_zero

theorem IsZeroSimple.isGreenJ_of_ne_zero (hS : IsZeroSimple S) {a b : S}

name: IsZeroSimple.exists_eq_mul
statement:
theorem IsZeroSimple.exists_eq_mul (hS : IsZeroSimple S) (b : S) :
    ∃ x y : S, b = x * y
proof:
:= by
  have hideal : IsSemigroupIdeal {z : S | ∃ x y : S, z = x * y} := by
    obtain ⟨u, v, _⟩ := hS.exists_mul_ne_zero
    refine ⟨⟨u * v, u, v, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨x, y, rfl⟩ s
    exact ⟨⟨s * x, y, (mul_assoc s x y).symm⟩, ⟨x, y * s, mul_assoc x y s⟩⟩
  rcases hS.ideal_eq_bot_or_top _ hideal with h | h
  · obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_mul_ne_zero
    have hmem : u * v ∈ {z : S | ∃ x y : S, z = x * y} := ⟨u, v, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact absurd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem) huv
  · exact Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp h b

name: IsZeroSimple.exists_mul_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsZeroSimple.exists_mul_mul_ne_zero (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ u v : S, u * a * v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  
  have hideal : IsSemigroupIdeal {x : S | ∀ u v : S, u * x * v = 0} := by
    refine ⟨⟨0, fun u v => by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro x hx s
    constructor
    · intro u v
      have h1 := hx (u * s) v
      rwa [mul_assoc u s x] at h1
    · intro u v
      have h2 := hx u (s * v)
      rw [← mul_assoc (u * x) s v] at h2
      rwa [mul_assoc u x s] at h2
  rcases hS.ideal_eq_bot_or_top _ hideal with h | h
  · 
    have hmem : a ∈ {x : S | ∀ u v : S, u * x * v = 0} := hcon
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact ha (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem)
  · 
    obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := hS.exists_mul_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨x, y, rfl⟩ := hS.exists_eq_mul q
    have hx : x ∈ {x : S | ∀ u v : S, u * x * v = 0} := Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp h x
    have h0 : p * x * y = 0 := hx p y
    rw [mul_assoc] at h0
    exact hpq h0

name: IsZeroSimple.exists_eq_mul_mul
statement:
theorem IsZeroSimple.exists_eq_mul_mul (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : S) : ∃ u v : S, b = u * a * v
proof:
:= by
  have hideal : IsSemigroupIdeal {z : S | ∃ u v : S, z = u * a * v} := by
    obtain ⟨u, v, _⟩ := hS.exists_mul_mul_ne_zero ha
    refine ⟨⟨u * a * v, u, v, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨u, v, rfl⟩ s
    refine ⟨⟨s * u, v, by simp only [mul_assoc]⟩, ⟨u, v * s, by simp only [mul_assoc]⟩⟩
  rcases hS.ideal_eq_bot_or_top _ hideal with h | h
  · obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_mul_mul_ne_zero ha
    have hmem : u * a * v ∈ {z : S | ∃ u v : S, z = u * a * v} := ⟨u, v, rfl⟩
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact absurd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem) huv
  · exact Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mp h b

name: ReesMatrix.mul_zero'
statement: protected lemma mul_zero' (x : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) : ReesMatrix.mul x zero = zero
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: ReesMatrix.zero_mul'
statement: protected lemma zero_mul' (x : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) : ReesMatrix.mul zero x = zero
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none
statement:
protected lemma mul_elem_of_none {l : Λ} {j : I} (h : P l j = none)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (elem i a l) (elem j b m) = (zero : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  change (match P l j with
    | none => zero
    | some p => elem i (a * p * b) m) = (zero : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
  rw [h]

name: ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some
statement:
protected lemma mul_elem_of_some {l : Λ} {j : I} {p : G} (h : P l j = some p)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (elem i a l) (elem j b m) = (elem i (a * p * b) m : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  change (match P l j with
    | none => zero
    | some q => elem i (a * q * b) m) = (elem i (a * p * b) m : ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
  rw [h]

name: ReesMatrix.mul_assoc'
statement:
protected theorem mul_assoc' (x y z : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) :
    ReesMatrix.mul (ReesMatrix.mul x y) z = ReesMatrix.mul x (ReesMatrix.mul y z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with _ | ⟨i, a, l⟩
  · rw [ReesMatrix.zero_mul', ReesMatrix.zero_mul', ReesMatrix.zero_mul']
  rcases y with _ | ⟨j, b, m⟩
  · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_zero', ReesMatrix.zero_mul', ReesMatrix.mul_zero']
  rcases z with _ | ⟨k, c, n⟩
  · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_zero', ReesMatrix.mul_zero', ReesMatrix.mul_zero']
  rcases hp : P l j with _ | p
  · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none hp, ReesMatrix.zero_mul']
    rcases hq : P m k with _ | q
    · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none hq, ReesMatrix.mul_zero']
    · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some hq, ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none hp]
  · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some hp]
    rcases hq : P m k with _ | q
    · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none hq, ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_none hq,
        ReesMatrix.mul_zero']
    · rw [ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some hq, ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some hq,
        ReesMatrix.mul_elem_of_some hp]
      congr 1
      simp [mul_assoc]

name: ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_none

@[simp] lemma elem_mul_of_none {l : Λ} {j : I} (h : P l j = none)

name: ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_some

@[simp] lemma elem_mul_of_some {l : Λ} {j : I} {p : G} (h : P l j = some p)
    (i : I) (a b : G) (m : Λ) :
    (elem i a l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) * elem j b m = elem i (a * p * b) m

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_hClass_factor
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_hClass_factor (hS : IsZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {r q x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hr : r 𝓛 e) (hq : q 𝓡 e)
    (hrx : r 𝓡 x) (hqx : q 𝓛 x) :
    ∃ g : S, g 𝓗 e ∧ x = r * g * q
proof:
:= by
  have hre : r * e = r := IsGreenLeftDvd.mul_idem_eq_self he.isIdempotentElem hr.1
  have heq : e * q = q := IsGreenRightDvd.idem_mul_eq_self he.isIdempotentElem hq.1
  obtain ⟨m, hxm, hem⟩ := exists_factor_right he.isIdempotentElem hre hrx.2
  obtain ⟨n, hxn, hne⟩ := exists_factor_left he.isIdempotentElem heq hqx.2
  obtain ⟨w, hwr, hew⟩ := hr.exists_left_retraction he.isIdempotentElem
  obtain ⟨w', hqw', hw'e⟩ := hq.exists_right_retraction he.isIdempotentElem
  
  have hrepr : r * (w * x * w') * q = x := by
    calc r * (w * x * w') * q = r * (w * r) * (m * (w' * q)) := by
          rw [hxm]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = r * e * (m * (w' * q)) := by rw [hwr]
      _ = r * (e * m) * (w' * q) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = x * (w' * q) := by rw [hem, ← hxm]
      _ = n * (q * w') * q := by rw [hxn]; simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = n * e * q := by rw [hqw']
      _ = x := by rw [hne, ← hxn]
  have hg0 : w * x * w' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hx (by rw [← hrepr, h0, mul_zero, zero_mul])
  refine ⟨w * x * w', he.isGreenH_of_corner hS hg0 ?_ ?_, hrepr.symm⟩
  · rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hew]
  · rw [mul_assoc, hw'e]

name: exists_hClass_coord
statement:
theorem exists_hClass_coord (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : S, g 𝓗 e ∧
      x = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hx) * g * colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx)
proof:
:=
  he.exists_hClass_factor hS.isZeroSimple hx
    (rowRep_isGreenL e (reesRIdxOf hS he hx))
    (colRep_isGreenR e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx))
    (GreenRClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (rowRep_mk e (reesRIdxOf hS he hx)))
    (GreenLClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (colRep_mk e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx)))

name: toRees_zero
statement:
theorem toRees_zero (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) :
    letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
    toRees hS he 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  dif_pos rfl

name: toRees_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem toRees_of_ne_zero (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    toRees hS he x = .elem (reesRIdxOf hS he hx)
      ⟨(exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose, (exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose_spec.1⟩
      (reesLIdxOf hS he hx)
proof:
:=
  dif_neg hx

name: rees_repr_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rees_repr_ne_zero {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) (i : ReesRIndex e) (l : ReesLIndex e)
    {g : S} (hg : g 𝓗 e) :
    rowRep e i * g * colRep e l ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenR he.isIdempotentElem he.ne_zero
    (isGreenL_mul_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenH he.isIdempotentElem
      (rowRep_isGreenL e i) hg)
    (colRep_isGreenR e l)

name: toRees_eq_elem
statement:
theorem toRees_eq_elem (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    {i : ReesRIndex e} {l : ReesLIndex e} {g : S} (hg : g 𝓗 e)
    (hrep : x = rowRep e i * g * colRep e l) :
    toRees hS he x = .elem i ⟨g, hg⟩ l
proof:
:= by
  
  have hxr : x 𝓡 rowRep e i :=
    isGreenR_left_of_repr he.isIdempotentElem (rowRep_isGreenL e i) hg
      (colRep_isGreenR e l) hrep
  have hxq : x 𝓛 colRep e l :=
    isGreenL_right_of_repr he.isIdempotentElem (rowRep_isGreenL e i) hg
      (colRep_isGreenR e l) hrep
  have hi : reesRIdxOf hS he hx = i := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← rowRep_mk e i]
    exact GreenRClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr hxr
  have hl : reesLIdxOf hS he hx = l := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [← colRep_mk e l]
    exact GreenLClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr hxq
  subst hi hl
  
  obtain ⟨hgx, hxrep⟩ := (exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose_spec
  have hgeq : (exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose = g :=
    hClass_coord_unique he.isIdempotentElem
      (rowRep_isGreenL e (reesRIdxOf hS he hx))
      (colRep_isGreenR e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx))
      hgx hg (hxrep.symm.trans hrep)
  rw [toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hx]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext hgeq

name: sandwich_isGreenH_of_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sandwich_isGreenH_of_mul_ne_zero (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x y : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hxy : x * y ≠ 0) :
    colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) 𝓗 e
proof:
:= by
  have heq : e * colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) = colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) :=
    idem_mul_colRep he.isIdempotentElem _
  have hre : rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) * e = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) :=
    rowRep_mul_idem he.isIdempotentElem _
  have hqx : colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) 𝓛 x :=
    GreenLClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (colRep_mk e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx))
  have hry : rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) 𝓡 y :=
    GreenRClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (rowRep_mk e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy))
  obtain ⟨n, hxn, -⟩ := exists_factor_left he.isIdempotentElem heq hqx.2
  obtain ⟨m, hym, -⟩ := exists_factor_right he.isIdempotentElem hre hry.2
  
  refine he.isGreenH_of_corner hS.isZeroSimple ?_
    (by rw [← mul_assoc, heq]) (by rw [mul_assoc, hre])
  intro h0
  apply hxy
  calc x * y
      = n * (colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy)) * m := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hxn, hym]
        simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_mul]

name: sandwich_none_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sandwich_none_of_mul_eq_zero (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x y : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hxy : x * y = 0) :
    sandwichMatrix e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) = none
proof:
:= by
  have hqx : colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) 𝓛 x :=
    GreenLClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (colRep_mk e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx))
  have hry : rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) 𝓡 y :=
    GreenRClass.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (rowRep_mk e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy))
  
  have h0 : colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) = 0 := by
    rcases hqx.1 with hqe | ⟨c, hqe⟩ <;> rcases hry.1 with hrye | ⟨d, hrye⟩
    · rw [hqe, hrye]; exact hxy
    · rw [hqe, hrye, ← mul_assoc, hxy, zero_mul]
    · rw [hqe, hrye, mul_assoc, hxy, mul_zero]
    · rw [hqe, hrye, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc x, hxy, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  exact dif_neg fun h => ne_zero_of_isGreenH h he.ne_zero h0

name: toRees_mul
statement:
theorem toRees_mul (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) (x y : S) :
    letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
    toRees hS he (x * y) = toRees hS he x * toRees hS he y
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  change toRees hS he (x * y) = toRees hS he x * toRees hS he y
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · 
    rw [hx, zero_mul, toRees_zero, zero_mul]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · 
    rw [hy, mul_zero, toRees_zero, mul_zero]
  by_cases hxy : x * y = 0
  · 
    rw [hxy, toRees_zero, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hx, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hy,
      ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_none (sandwich_none_of_mul_eq_zero hS he hx hy hxy)]
  · have hsand := sandwich_isGreenH_of_mul_ne_zero hS he hx hy hxy
    have hsome : sandwichMatrix e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) (reesRIdxOf hS he hy) =
        some ⟨colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy), hsand⟩ :=
      dif_pos hsand
    obtain ⟨hgx, hrx⟩ := (exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose_spec
    obtain ⟨hgy, hry⟩ := (exists_hClass_coord hS he hy).choose_spec
    have hmid : (exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose *
        (colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy)) *
        (exists_hClass_coord hS he hy).choose 𝓗 e :=
      IsGreenH.mul_mem he.isIdempotentElem
        (IsGreenH.mul_mem he.isIdempotentElem hgx hsand) hgy
    have hrep : x * y = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hx) *
        ((exists_hClass_coord hS he hx).choose *
          (colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hx) * rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hy)) *
          (exists_hClass_coord hS he hy).choose) *
        colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hy) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hrx, hry]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    rw [toRees_eq_elem hS he hxy hmid hrep, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hx,
      toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hy, ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_some hsome]
    
    
    congr 1

name: toRees_bijective
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  constructor
  · 
    intro a b hab
    by_cases ha : a = 0 <;> by_cases hb : b = 0
    · rw [ha, hb]
    · rw [ha, toRees_zero, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hb] at hab
      exact absurd hab ReesMatrix.zero_ne_elem
    · rw [hb, toRees_zero, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he ha] at hab
      exact absurd hab ReesMatrix.elem_ne_zero
    · 
      rw [toRees_of_ne_zero hS he ha, toRees_of_ne_zero hS he hb] at hab
      injection hab with h1 h2 h3
      
      
      have hg : (exists_hClass_coord hS he ha).choose =
          (exists_hClass_coord hS he hb).choose := congrArg Subtype.val h2
      have hr : rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he ha) = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hb) :=
        congrArg (rowRep e) h1
      have hc : colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he ha) = colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hb) :=
        congrArg (colRep e) h3
      calc a = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he ha) * (exists_hClass_coord hS he ha).choose *
            colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he ha) := (exists_hClass_coord hS he ha).choose_spec.2
        _ = rowRep e (reesRIdxOf hS he hb) * (exists_hClass_coord hS he hb).choose *
            colRep e (reesLIdxOf hS he hb) := by
            rw [hg, hr, hc]
        _ = b := ((exists_hClass_coord hS he hb).choose_spec.2).symm
  · 
    intro M
    rcases M with _ | ⟨i, g, l⟩
    · exact ⟨0, toRees_zero hS he⟩
    · exact ⟨rowRep e i * g.1 * colRep e l,
        toRees_eq_elem hS he (rees_repr_ne_zero he i l g.2) g.2 rfl⟩

name: rees_theorem
statement:
theorem rees_theorem (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) :
    letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
    Nonempty (S ≃* ReesMatrix (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) (ReesRIndex e) (ReesLIndex e)
      (sandwichMatrix e))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  refine ⟨⟨Equiv.ofBijective _ (toRees_bijective hS he), fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  exact toRees_mul hS he x y

name: reesMatrix_isZeroSimple
statement:
theorem reesMatrix_isZeroSimple [Nonempty I]
    (hrow : ∀ l : Λ, ∃ i : I, ∃ p : G, P l i = some p)
    (hcol : ∀ i : I, ∃ l : Λ, ∃ p : G, P l i = some p) :
    IsZeroSimple (ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
    obtain ⟨l, p, hp⟩ := hcol i
    exact ⟨elem i 1 l, elem i 1 l, by rw [elem_mul_of_some hp]; exact elem_ne_zero⟩
  · intro T hT
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, hcl⟩ := hT
    have h0 : (0 : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) ∈ T := by
      have h := (hcl a ha 0).1
      rwa [zero_mul] at h
    by_cases hex : ∃ x ∈ T, x ≠ 0
    · 
      right
      obtain ⟨x, hxT, hx0⟩ := hex
      rcases x with _ | ⟨i, g, l⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hx0
      obtain ⟨l₁, p, hp⟩ := hcol i
      obtain ⟨i₂, q, hq⟩ := hrow l
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      rcases y with _ | ⟨j, b, m⟩
      · exact h0
      · have h1 : elem j (b * (p * g * q)⁻¹ * p * g) l ∈ T := by
          have h := (hcl _ hxT (elem j (b * (p * g * q)⁻¹) l₁)).1
          rwa [elem_mul_of_some hp] at h
        have h2 : elem j (b * (p * g * q)⁻¹ * p * g * q * 1) m ∈ T := by
          have h := (hcl _ h1 (elem i₂ 1 m)).2
          rwa [elem_mul_of_some hq] at h
        have heq : b * (p * g * q)⁻¹ * p * g * q * 1 = b := by
          simp [mul_assoc]
        rwa [heq] at h2
    · 
      left
      refine Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨h0, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      by_contra hx0
      exact hex ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩

name: reesMatrix_isPrimitiveIdempotent
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    have h : (elem i p⁻¹ l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) * elem i p⁻¹ l = elem i p⁻¹ l := by
      rw [elem_mul_of_some hp, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
    exact h
  · exact elem_ne_zero
  · intro f hf hf0 hef hfe
    rcases f with _ | ⟨j, b, m⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hf0
    
    rcases hpj : P l j with _ | r
    · rw [elem_mul_of_none hpj] at hef
      exact absurd hef zero_ne_elem
    rw [elem_mul_of_some hpj] at hef
    injection hef with h1 _ _
    subst h1
    
    rcases hpm : P m i with _ | s
    · rw [elem_mul_of_none hpm] at hfe
      exact absurd hfe zero_ne_elem
    rw [elem_mul_of_some hpm] at hfe
    injection hfe with _ _ h3
    subst h3
    
    have hff : (elem i b l : ReesMatrix G I Λ P) * elem i b l = elem i b l := hf
    rw [elem_mul_of_some hp] at hff
    injection hff with _ hmid _
    have hpb : p * b = 1 :=
      mul_left_cancel (a := b) (by rw [← mul_assoc, hmid, mul_one])
    rw [(inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hpb).symm]

name: rees_theorem_converse
statement:
theorem rees_theorem_converse [Nonempty I]
    (hrow : ∀ l : Λ, ∃ i : I, ∃ p : G, P l i = some p)
    (hcol : ∀ i : I, ∃ l : Λ, ∃ p : G, P l i = some p) :
    IsCompletelyZeroSimple (ReesMatrix G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨reesMatrix_isZeroSimple hrow hcol, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
  obtain ⟨l, p, hp⟩ := hcol i
  exact ⟨elem i p⁻¹ l, reesMatrix_isPrimitiveIdempotent hp⟩

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_corner_inv
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_corner_inv (hS : IsZeroSimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hea : e * a = a) (hae : a * e = a) :
    ∃ b : S, e * b = b ∧ b * e = b ∧ a * b = e ∧ b * a = e
proof:
:= by
  have hee := he.isIdempotentElem.eq
  
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_eq_mul_mul ha e
  set p := e * u * e with hp
  set q := e * v * e with hq
  have hpaq : p * a * q = e := by
    calc p * a * q = e * (u * (e * a * e) * v) * e := by
          simp only [hp, hq, mul_assoc]
      _ = e * (u * a * v) * e := by rw [hea, hae]
      _ = e := by rw [← huv, hee, hee]
  have hep : e * p = p := by rw [hp, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hee]
  have hpe : p * e = p := by rw [hp, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hee, ← mul_assoc]
  have heq : e * q = q := by rw [hq, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hee]
  have hqe : q * e = q := by rw [hq, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hee, ← mul_assoc]
  
  have haqp : a * q * p = e := by
    set f := a * q * p with hf
    have hff : IsIdempotentElem f := by
      change f * f = f
      calc f * f = a * q * (p * a * q) * p := by simp only [hf, mul_assoc]
        _ = a * q * e * p := by rw [hpaq]
        _ = f := by rw [hf, mul_assoc a, mul_assoc a, hqe, ← mul_assoc a]
    have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply he.ne_zero
      calc e = p * a * q * (p * a * q) := by rw [hpaq, hee]
        _ = p * f * (a * q) := by simp only [hf, mul_assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hef : e * f = f := by rw [hf, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc e a q, hea]
    have hfe : f * e = f := by rw [hf, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hpe, ← mul_assoc]
    exact he.eq_of_le f hff hf0 hef hfe
  
  have hqpa : q * p * a = e := by
    set g := q * p * a with hg
    have hgg : IsIdempotentElem g := by
      change g * g = g
      calc g * g = q * (p * a * q) * (p * a) := by simp only [hg, mul_assoc]
        _ = q * e * (p * a) := by rw [hpaq]
        _ = g := by rw [hqe, hg, mul_assoc q p a]
    have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply he.ne_zero
      calc e = p * a * q * (p * a * q) := by rw [hpaq, hee]
        _ = p * a * g * q := by simp only [hg, mul_assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have heg : e * g = g := by rw [hg, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, heq]
    have hge : g * e = g := by rw [hg, mul_assoc, hae]
    exact he.eq_of_le g hgg hg0 heg hge
  
  refine ⟨q * p, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← mul_assoc, heq]
  · rw [mul_assoc, hpe]
  · rw [← mul_assoc]; exact haqp
  · rw [mul_assoc]; rw [mul_assoc] at hqpa; exact hqpa

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isGreenH_of_corner
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, _, _, hab, hba⟩ := he.exists_corner_inv hS ha hea hae
  exact ⟨⟨Or.inr ⟨a, hae.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨b, hba.symm⟩⟩,
         ⟨Or.inr ⟨a, hea.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨b, hab.symm⟩⟩⟩

name: IsIdempotentElem.withZero
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.withZero {e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    IsIdempotentElem (e : WithZero S)
proof:
:= by
  change (e : WithZero S) * e = e
  rw [← WithZero.coe_mul, he.eq]

name: IsSimple.isZeroSimple_withZero
statement:
theorem IsSimple.isZeroSimple_withZero (hS : IsSimple S) :
    IsZeroSimple (WithZero S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := hS.nonempty
  refine ⟨⟨a, a, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← WithZero.coe_mul]
    exact WithZero.coe_ne_zero
  · intro T hT
    obtain ⟨⟨t, htT⟩, hTmul⟩ := hT
    
    have h0 : (0 : WithZero S) ∈ T := by
      have h := (hTmul t htT 0).1
      rwa [zero_mul] at h
    by_cases hbot : T = {0}
    · exact Or.inl hbot
    right
    
    have hex : ∃ x ∈ T, x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      exact hbot (Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨h0, hcon⟩)
    obtain ⟨x, hxT, hx0⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := WithZero.ne_zero_iff_exists.mp hx0
    
    have hT' : IsSemigroupIdeal {y : S | (y : WithZero S) ∈ T} := by
      refine ⟨⟨b, hxT⟩, ?_⟩
      intro c hcT s
      constructor
      · have h := (hTmul _ hcT (s : WithZero S)).1
        rwa [← WithZero.coe_mul] at h
      · have h := (hTmul _ hcT (s : WithZero S)).2
        rwa [← WithZero.coe_mul] at h
    have huniv := hS.ideal_eq_top _ hT'
    
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    by_cases hz : z = 0
    · subst hz
      exact h0
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := WithZero.ne_zero_iff_exists.mp hz
      have hy : y ∈ {y : S | (y : WithZero S) ∈ T} := by
        rw [huniv]
        exact Set.mem_univ y
      exact hy

name: IsSimplePrimitiveIdempotent.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨he.isIdempotentElem.withZero, WithZero.coe_ne_zero, ?_⟩
  intro f hf hf0 hef hfe
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := WithZero.ne_zero_iff_exists.mp hf0
  have hg : IsIdempotentElem g := by
    have h : (g : WithZero S) * g = g := hf
    rw [← WithZero.coe_mul] at h
    exact WithZero.coe_inj.mp h
  have heg : e * g = g := by
    rw [← WithZero.coe_mul] at hef
    exact WithZero.coe_inj.mp hef
  have hge : g * e = g := by
    rw [← WithZero.coe_mul] at hfe
    exact WithZero.coe_inj.mp hfe
  exact WithZero.coe_inj.mpr (he.eq_of_le g hg heg hge)

name: IsCompletelySimple.isCompletelyZeroSimple_withZero
statement:
theorem IsCompletelySimple.isCompletelyZeroSimple_withZero
    (hS : IsCompletelySimple S) : IsCompletelyZeroSimple (WithZero S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hS.exists_primitive
  exact ⟨hS.isSimple.isZeroSimple_withZero,
    ⟨(e : WithZero S), he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero⟩⟩

name: ReesMatrixSimple.mul_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma mul_def (x y : ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) :
    x * y = ⟨x.row, x.mid * P x.col y.row * y.mid, y.col⟩
proof: := rfl

name: sandwich_isGreenH_of_noZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem sandwich_isGreenH_of_noZeroDivisors (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S₀)
    {e : S₀} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) (l : ReesLIndex e) (i : ReesRIndex e) :
    colRep e l * rowRep e i 𝓗 e
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : colRep e l ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_isGreenR (colRep_isGreenR e l) he.ne_zero
  have h2 : rowRep e i ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_isGreenL (rowRep_isGreenL e i) he.ne_zero
  refine he.isGreenH_of_corner hS.isZeroSimple (mul_ne_zero h1 h2) ?_ ?_
  · rw [← mul_assoc, idem_mul_colRep he.isIdempotentElem]
  · rw [mul_assoc, rowRep_mul_idem he.isIdempotentElem]

name: sandwichMatrix_eq_some
proof:
:=
  dif_pos (sandwich_isGreenH_of_noZeroDivisors hS he l i)

name: toRees_coe
statement:
theorem toRees_coe (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple (WithZero S))
    {e : WithZero S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) (x : S) :
    toRees hS he ↑x = .elem (toReesSimple hS he x).row (toReesSimple hS he x).mid
      (toReesSimple hS he x).col
proof:
:=
  toRees_of_ne_zero hS he WithZero.coe_ne_zero

name: toReesSimple_mul
statement:
theorem toReesSimple_mul (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple (WithZero S))
    {e : WithZero S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) (x y : S) :
    letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
    toReesSimple hS he (x * y) = toReesSimple hS he x * toReesSimple hS he y
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  have hmul : toRees hS he (↑x * ↑y) = toRees hS he ↑x * toRees hS he ↑y :=
    toRees_mul hS he ↑x ↑y
  rw [← WithZero.coe_mul, toRees_coe hS he (x * y), toRees_coe hS he x,
    toRees_coe hS he y,
    ReesMatrix.elem_mul_of_some (sandwichMatrix_eq_some hS he _ _)] at hmul
  injection hmul with h1 h2 h3
  exact ReesMatrixSimple.ext h1 h2 h3

name: toReesSimple_bijective
statement:
theorem toReesSimple_bijective (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple (WithZero S))
    {e : WithZero S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) :
    Function.Bijective (toReesSimple hS he)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass e) := he.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  constructor
  · 
    intro a b hab
    have h : toRees hS he ↑a = toRees hS he ↑b := by
      rw [toRees_coe hS he a, toRees_coe hS he b, hab]
    exact WithZero.coe_inj.mp ((toRees_bijective hS he).1 h)
  · 
    rintro ⟨i, g, l⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (toRees_bijective hS he).2 (ReesMatrix.elem i g l)
    have h0 : toRees hS he 0 = 0 := toRees_zero hS he
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [h0] at hz
      exact ReesMatrix.zero_ne_elem hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := WithZero.ne_zero_iff_exists.mp hz0
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    have h := (toRees_coe hS he x).symm.trans hz
    injection h with h1 h2 h3
    exact ReesMatrixSimple.ext h1 h2 h3

name: rees_theorem_simple
statement:
theorem rees_theorem_simple (hS : IsCompletelySimple S) {e : S}
    (he : IsSimplePrimitiveIdempotent e) :
    letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass (e : WithZero S)) :=
      he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
    Nonempty (S ≃* ReesMatrixSimple (IsGreenH.eqvClass (e : WithZero S))
      (ReesRIndex (e : WithZero S)) (ReesLIndex (e : WithZero S))
      (simpleSandwich hS.isCompletelyZeroSimple_withZero
        he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Group (IsGreenH.eqvClass (e : WithZero S)) :=
    he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero.isIdempotentElem.hClassGroup
  refine ⟨⟨Equiv.ofBijective _
    (toReesSimple_bijective hS.isCompletelyZeroSimple_withZero
      he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero), fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  exact toReesSimple_mul hS.isCompletelyZeroSimple_withZero
    he.isPrimitiveIdempotent_withZero x y

name: reesMatrixSimple_isSimple
statement:
theorem reesMatrixSimple_isSimple [Nonempty I] [Nonempty Λ] :
    IsSimple (ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
  obtain ⟨l₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty Λ›
  refine ⟨⟨⟨i₀, 1, l₀⟩⟩, fun T hT => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, hcl⟩ := hT
  obtain ⟨i, g, l⟩ := a
  ext y
  obtain ⟨j, b, m⟩ := y
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  
  have h1 : (⟨j, b * (P l₀ i * g * P l j)⁻¹, l₀⟩ * ⟨i, g, l⟩ :
      ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) ∈ T :=
    (hcl _ ha _).1
  have h2 : (⟨j, b * (P l₀ i * g * P l j)⁻¹, l₀⟩ * ⟨i, g, l⟩ :
      ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) * ⟨j, 1, m⟩ ∈ T :=
    (hcl _ h1 _).2
  have heq : (⟨j, b * (P l₀ i * g * P l j)⁻¹, l₀⟩ * ⟨i, g, l⟩ :
      ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) * ⟨j, 1, m⟩ = ⟨j, b, m⟩ := by
    simp [mul_def, mul_assoc]
  rwa [heq] at h2

name: reesMatrixSimple_isSimplePrimitiveIdempotent
statement:
theorem reesMatrixSimple_isSimplePrimitiveIdempotent (i : I) (l : Λ) :
    IsSimplePrimitiveIdempotent (⟨i, (P l i)⁻¹, l⟩ : ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    have h : (⟨i, (P l i)⁻¹, l⟩ * ⟨i, (P l i)⁻¹, l⟩ : ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P) =
        ⟨i, (P l i)⁻¹, l⟩ := by
      simp [mul_def]
    exact h
  · rintro ⟨j, b, m⟩ hf hef hfe
    
    have h1 : i = j := congrArg ReesMatrixSimple.row hef
    subst h1
    have h3 : l = m := congrArg ReesMatrixSimple.col hfe
    subst h3
    
    have hmid : b * P l i * b = b := congrArg ReesMatrixSimple.mid hf
    have hpb : P l i * b = 1 :=
      mul_left_cancel (a := b) (by rw [← mul_assoc, hmid, mul_one])
    rw [(inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hpb).symm]

name: rees_theorem_simple_converse
statement:
theorem rees_theorem_simple_converse [Nonempty I] [Nonempty Λ] :
    IsCompletelySimple (ReesMatrixSimple G I Λ P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
  obtain ⟨l⟩ := ‹Nonempty Λ›
  exact ⟨reesMatrixSimple_isSimple,
    ⟨⟨i, (P l i)⁻¹, l⟩, reesMatrixSimple_isSimplePrimitiveIdempotent i l⟩⟩

name: ne_zero_of_isGreenL
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_isGreenL {x e : S} (h : x 𝓛 e) (he : e ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  rcases h.2 with h0 | ⟨c, hc⟩
  · exact he h0
  · exact he (by rw [hc, mul_zero])

name: ne_zero_of_isGreenR
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_isGreenR {x e : S} (h : x 𝓡 e) (he : e ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  rcases h.2 with h0 | ⟨c, hc⟩
  · exact he h0
  · exact he (by rw [hc, zero_mul])

name: ne_zero_of_isGreenH
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_isGreenH {x e : S} (h : x 𝓗 e) (he : e ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_zero_of_isGreenL h.1 he

name: mul_ne_zero_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenR
statement:
theorem mul_ne_zero_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenR {e x y : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (he0 : e ≠ 0) (hx : x 𝓛 e) (hy : y 𝓡 e) : x * y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy
  rcases hx.2 with hex | ⟨c, hc⟩ <;> rcases hy.2 with hey | ⟨d, hd⟩
  · exact he0 (by rw [← hxy, ← hex, ← hey, he.eq])
  · exact he0 (by
      calc e = x * (y * d) := by rw [← hex, ← hd, he.eq]
        _ = x * y * d := (mul_assoc x y d).symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxy, zero_mul])
  · exact he0 (by
      calc e = c * x * y := by rw [← hc, ← hey, he.eq]
        _ = c * (x * y) := mul_assoc c x y
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxy, mul_zero])
  · exact he0 (by
      calc e = c * x * (y * d) := by rw [← hc, ← hd, he.eq]
        _ = c * (x * y) * d := by simp only [mul_assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxy, mul_zero, zero_mul])

name: op_rightDvd_op_iff
statement: lemma op_rightDvd_op_iff {a b : S} : RightDvd (op a) (op b) ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨unop c, op_injective (by simp [hc])⟩,
   fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨op c, by simp [hc]⟩⟩

name: op_dvd_op_iff
statement: lemma op_dvd_op_iff {a b : S} : op a ∣ op b ↔ RightDvd a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨unop c, op_injective (by simp [hc])⟩,
   fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨op c, by simp [hc]⟩⟩

name: isGreenRightDvd_iff_isGreenLeftDvd_op
statement:
lemma isGreenRightDvd_iff_isGreenLeftDvd_op {a b : S} :

proof:
:=

name: isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR
statement:
lemma isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR {a b z : S} (hL : a 𝓛 z) (hR : z 𝓡 b) :
    ∃ z', a 𝓡 z' ∧ z' 𝓛 b
proof:
:=
  match hL, hR with
  | ⟨.inl rfl, _⟩, hR' | ⟨_, .inl rfl⟩, hR' => ⟨b, hR', IsGreenL.refl b⟩
  | hL', ⟨.inl rfl, _⟩ | hL', ⟨_, .inl rfl⟩ => ⟨a, IsGreenR.refl a, hL'⟩
  | ⟨.inr ⟨u, hu⟩, .inr ⟨v, hv⟩⟩, ⟨.inr ⟨x, hx⟩, .inr ⟨y, hy⟩⟩ =>
    ⟨a * y,
      ⟨.inr ⟨x, by simp [hu, ← hy, ← hx, mul_assoc]⟩, .inr ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩,
      ⟨.inr ⟨u, by simp [hu, ← hy, mul_assoc]⟩, .inr ⟨v, by simp [← hv, hy, ← mul_assoc]⟩⟩⟩

name: IsGreenD.refl

proof: := ⟨a, IsGreenL.refl a, IsGreenR.refl a⟩

name: IsGreenD.symm
statement: @[symm] theorem symm {a b : S} : a 𝓓 b → b 𝓓 a
proof: | ⟨_, hL, hR⟩ => let ⟨y, hyR, hyL⟩ := isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR hL hR; ⟨y, hyL.symm, hyR.symm⟩

name: IsGreenD.trans
statement: @[trans] theorem trans {a b c : S} : a 𝓓 b → b 𝓓 c → a 𝓓 c
proof:
| ⟨_, hL1, hR1⟩, ⟨_, hL2, hR2⟩ =>
    let ⟨z, hR3, hL3⟩ := isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR hL2.symm hR1.symm
    ⟨z, hL1.trans hL3.symm, hR3.symm.trans hR2⟩

name: IsGreenD.isGreenD_iff_isGreenD_op
statement: lemma isGreenD_iff_isGreenD_op {a b : S} : a 𝓓 b ↔ op a 𝓓 op b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, hL, hR⟩ ↦
    let ⟨y, hyR, hyL⟩ := isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR hL hR
    ⟨op y, isGreenR_iff_isGreenL_op.mp hyR, isGreenL_iff_isGreenR_op.mp hyL⟩,
   fun ⟨_, hL, hR⟩ ↦
    let ⟨y, hyR, hyL⟩ := isGreenL_commutes_isGreenR (isGreenL_iff_isGreenR_op.mpr hR).symm
      (isGreenR_iff_isGreenL_op.mpr hL).symm
    ⟨y, hyL.symm, hyR.symm⟩⟩

lemma isGreenLeftDvd_respects (a₁ b₁ a₂ b₂ : S)

name: IsGreenLeftDvd.mul_idem_eq_self
statement:
theorem mul_idem_eq_self (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (h : x ≤𝓛 e) :
    x * e = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · exact he.eq
  · rw [mul_assoc, he.eq]

name: IsGreenLeftDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_of_idem (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (h : e ≤𝓛 x) :
    ∃ u, e = u * x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨u, hu⟩
  · exact ⟨e, by rw [← h]; exact he.eq.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨u, hu⟩

name: IsGreenRightDvd.idem_mul_eq_self
statement:
theorem idem_mul_eq_self (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (h : x ≤𝓡 e) :
    e * x = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩
  · exact he.eq
  · rw [← mul_assoc, he.eq]

name: IsGreenRightDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_of_idem (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (h : e ≤𝓡 x) :
    ∃ v, e = x * v
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨v, hv⟩
  · exact ⟨e, by rw [← h]; exact he.eq.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨v, hv⟩

name: IsGreenL.exists_left_retraction
statement:
theorem IsGreenL.exists_left_retraction {r e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (h : r 𝓛 e) : ∃ w, w * r = e ∧ e * w = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsGreenLeftDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem he h.2
  exact ⟨e * u, by rw [mul_assoc, ← hu, he.eq], by rw [← mul_assoc, he.eq]⟩

statement:
theorem IsGreenR.exists_right_retraction {c e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (h : c 𝓡 e) : ∃ w, c * w = e ∧ w * e = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := IsGreenRightDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem he h.2
  exact ⟨d * e, by rw [← mul_assoc, ← hd, he.eq], by rw [mul_assoc, he.eq]⟩

name: exists_factor_right
statement:
theorem exists_factor_right {r x e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hre : r * e = r) (h : x ≤𝓡 r) : ∃ m, x = r * m ∧ e * m = m
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩
  · exact ⟨e, hre.symm, he.eq⟩
  · exact ⟨e * a, by rw [ha, ← mul_assoc, hre], by rw [← mul_assoc, he.eq]⟩

name: exists_factor_left
statement:
theorem exists_factor_left {c x e : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hec : e * c = c) (h : x ≤𝓛 c) : ∃ n, x = n * c ∧ n * e = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩
  · exact ⟨e, hec.symm, he.eq⟩
  · exact ⟨a * e, by rw [ha, mul_assoc, hec], by rw [mul_assoc, he.eq]⟩

name: isGreenL_mul_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenH
statement:
theorem isGreenL_mul_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenH {e r g : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hr : r 𝓛 e) (hg : g 𝓗 e) : r * g 𝓛 e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hwr, _⟩ := hr.exists_left_retraction he
  obtain ⟨g', _, _, hg'g⟩ := IsGreenH.exists_inv he hg
  constructor
  · rcases hg.1.1 with rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨r, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨r * c, (mul_assoc r c e).symm⟩
  · refine Or.inr ⟨g' * w, ?_⟩
    have hge : e * g = g := IsGreenH.mul_left_eq_self he hg
    calc e = g' * g := hg'g.symm
      _ = g' * (e * g) := by rw [hge]
      _ = g' * (w * r * g) := by rw [hwr]
      _ = g' * w * (r * g) := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: isGreenR_mul_of_isGreenH_of_isGreenR
statement:
theorem isGreenR_mul_of_isGreenH_of_isGreenR {e g q : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hg : g 𝓗 e) (hq : q 𝓡 e) : g * q 𝓡 e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hqw, _⟩ := hq.exists_right_retraction he
  obtain ⟨g', _, hgg', _⟩ := IsGreenH.exists_inv he hg
  constructor
  · rcases hg.2.1 with rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨q, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨c * q, mul_assoc e c q⟩
  · refine Or.inr ⟨w * g', ?_⟩
    have hge : g * e = g := IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self he hg
    calc e = g * g' := hgg'.symm
      _ = g * e * g' := by rw [hge]
      _ = g * (q * w) * g' := by rw [hqw]
      _ = g * q * (w * g') := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: hClass_coord_unique
statement:
theorem hClass_coord_unique {e r q g₁ g₂ : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hr : r 𝓛 e) (hq : q 𝓡 e) (hg₁ : g₁ 𝓗 e)
    (hg₂ : g₂ 𝓗 e) (h : r * g₁ * q = r * g₂ * q) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hwr, _⟩ := hr.exists_left_retraction he
  obtain ⟨w', hqw', _⟩ := hq.exists_right_retraction he
  have cancel : ∀ g : S, g 𝓗 e → w * (r * g * q) * w' = g := by
    intro g hg
    calc w * (r * g * q) * w' = w * r * g * (q * w') := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = e * g * e := by rw [hwr, hqw']
      _ = g := by
          rw [IsGreenH.mul_left_eq_self he hg, IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self he hg]
  calc g₁ = w * (r * g₁ * q) * w' := (cancel g₁ hg₁).symm
    _ = w * (r * g₂ * q) * w' := by rw [h]
    _ = g₂ := cancel g₂ hg₂

name: isGreenR_left_of_repr
statement:
theorem isGreenR_left_of_repr {e r g q x : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hr : r 𝓛 e) (hg : g 𝓗 e) (hq : q 𝓡 e)
    (hrep : x = r * g * q) : x 𝓡 r
proof:
:= by
  have hre : r * e = r := IsGreenLeftDvd.mul_idem_eq_self he hr.1
  have hgq : g * q 𝓡 e := isGreenR_mul_of_isGreenH_of_isGreenR he hg hq
  constructor
  · exact Or.inr ⟨g * q, by rw [hrep]; simp only [mul_assoc]⟩
  · rcases hgq.2 with hgqe | ⟨c, hc⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by
        calc r = r * e := hre.symm
          _ = r * (g * q) := by rw [hgqe]
          _ = x := by rw [hrep]; simp only [mul_assoc])
    · refine Or.inr ⟨c, ?_⟩
      calc r = r * e := hre.symm
        _ = r * (g * q * c) := by rw [hc]
        _ = x * c := by rw [hrep]; simp only [mul_assoc]

name: isGreenL_right_of_repr
statement:
theorem isGreenL_right_of_repr {e r g q x : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hr : r 𝓛 e) (hg : g 𝓗 e) (hq : q 𝓡 e)
    (hrep : x = r * g * q) : x 𝓛 q
proof:
:= by
  have heq : e * q = q := IsGreenRightDvd.idem_mul_eq_self he hq.1
  have hrg : r * g 𝓛 e := isGreenL_mul_of_isGreenL_of_isGreenH he hr hg
  constructor
  · exact Or.inr ⟨r * g, hrep⟩
  · rcases hrg.2 with hrge | ⟨c, hc⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by
        calc q = e * q := heq.symm
          _ = r * g * q := by rw [hrge]
          _ = x := hrep.symm)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨c, ?_⟩
      calc q = e * q := heq.symm
        _ = c * (r * g) * q := by rw [hc]
        _ = c * x := by rw [hrep]; simp only [mul_assoc]

name: greens_lemma_right
statement:
theorem greens_lemma_right {a b u v : S} (hu : b = a * u) (hv : a = b * v) :
    Set.BijOn (· * u) (IsGreenL.eqvClass a) (IsGreenL.eqvClass b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel : a * u * v = a := by rw [← hu, ← hv]
  have hcancel' : b * v * u = b := by rw [← hv, ← hu]
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · have h1 : x * u 𝓛 a * u := IsGreenL.mul_right u hx
    rwa [← hu] at h1
  · have hxy' : x * u = y * u := hxy
    have hx' : x * u * v = x := IsGreenL.cancellation hx hcancel
    have hy' : y * u * v = y := IsGreenL.cancellation hy hcancel
    rw [← hx', ← hy', hxy']
  · refine ⟨y * v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : y * v 𝓛 b * v := IsGreenL.mul_right v hy
      rwa [← hv] at h1
    · exact IsGreenL.cancellation hy hcancel'

name: greens_lemma_left
statement:
theorem greens_lemma_left {a b u v : S} (hu : b = u * a) (hv : a = v * b) :
    Set.BijOn (u * ·) (IsGreenR.eqvClass a) (IsGreenR.eqvClass b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel : v * u * a = a := by rw [mul_assoc, ← hu, ← hv]
  have hcancel' : u * v * b = b := by rw [mul_assoc, ← hv, ← hu]
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · have h1 : u * x 𝓡 u * a := IsGreenR.mul_left u hx
    rwa [← hu] at h1
  · have hxy' : u * x = u * y := hxy
    have hx' : v * u * x = x := IsGreenR.cancellation hx hcancel
    have hy' : v * u * y = y := IsGreenR.cancellation hy hcancel
    rw [← hx', ← hy', mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hxy']
  · refine ⟨v * y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : v * y 𝓡 v * b := IsGreenR.mul_left v hy
      rwa [← hv] at h1
    · change u * (v * y) = y
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact IsGreenR.cancellation hy hcancel'

name: greens_lemma_right_hClass
statement:
theorem greens_lemma_right_hClass {a b u v : S} (hu : b = a * u) (hv : a = b * v) :
    Set.BijOn (· * u) (IsGreenH.eqvClass a) (IsGreenH.eqvClass b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel' : b * v * u = b := by rw [← hv, ← hu]
  
  
  have hmaps : ∀ {a' b' u' v' : S}, b' = a' * u' → a' = b' * v' →
      ∀ x ∈ IsGreenH.eqvClass a', x * u' ∈ IsGreenH.eqvClass b' := by
    intro a' b' u' v' hu' hv' x hx
    have hab' : a' 𝓡 b' := ⟨Or.inr ⟨v', hv'⟩, Or.inr ⟨u', hu'⟩⟩
    have hcancel : a' * u' * v' = a' := by rw [← hu', ← hv']
    have hxL : x * u' 𝓛 b' := by
      have h1 : x * u' 𝓛 a' * u' := IsGreenL.mul_right u' hx.1
      rwa [← hu'] at h1
    have hxuv : x * u' * v' = x := IsGreenL.cancellation hx.1 hcancel
    have hxR : x * u' 𝓡 x := ⟨Or.inr ⟨u', rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨v', hxuv.symm⟩⟩
    exact ⟨hxL, hxR.trans (hx.2.trans hab')⟩
  refine ⟨fun x hx => hmaps hu hv x hx, ?_, fun y hy => ⟨y * v, hmaps hv hu y hy, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact ((greens_lemma_right hu hv).2.1).mono fun x hx => hx.1
  · exact IsGreenL.cancellation hy.1 hcancel'

name: greens_lemma_left_hClass
statement:
theorem greens_lemma_left_hClass {a b u v : S} (hu : b = u * a) (hv : a = v * b) :
    Set.BijOn (u * ·) (IsGreenH.eqvClass a) (IsGreenH.eqvClass b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcancel' : u * v * b = b := by rw [mul_assoc, ← hv, ← hu]
  have hmaps : ∀ {a' b' u' v' : S}, b' = u' * a' → a' = v' * b' →
      ∀ x ∈ IsGreenH.eqvClass a', u' * x ∈ IsGreenH.eqvClass b' := by
    intro a' b' u' v' hu' hv' x hx
    have hab' : a' 𝓛 b' := ⟨Or.inr ⟨v', hv'⟩, Or.inr ⟨u', hu'⟩⟩
    have hcancel : v' * u' * a' = a' := by rw [mul_assoc, ← hu', ← hv']
    have hxR : u' * x 𝓡 b' := by
      have h1 : u' * x 𝓡 u' * a' := IsGreenR.mul_left u' hx.2
      rwa [← hu'] at h1
    have hxvu : v' * u' * x = x := IsGreenR.cancellation hx.2 hcancel
    have hxL : u' * x 𝓛 x :=
      ⟨Or.inr ⟨u', rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨v', by rw [← mul_assoc, hxvu]⟩⟩
    exact ⟨hxL.trans (hx.1.trans hab'), hxR⟩
  refine ⟨fun x hx => hmaps hu hv x hx, ?_, fun y hy => ⟨v * y, hmaps hv hu y hy, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact ((greens_lemma_left hu hv).2.1).mono fun x hx => hx.2
  · change u * (v * y) = y
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact IsGreenR.cancellation hy.2 hcancel'

name: IsGreenL.exists_hClass_bijOn
statement:
theorem IsGreenL.exists_hClass_bijOn {a b : S} (h : a 𝓛 b) :

name: IsGreenD.exists_linking_pair
statement:
theorem IsGreenD.exists_linking_pair {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hD : e 𝓓 f) :
    ∃ p q : S, p * q = e ∧ q * p = f ∧
      e * p = p ∧ p * f = p ∧ f * q = q ∧ q * e = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpL, hpR⟩ := hD.symm
  have hep : e * p = p := IsGreenRightDvd.idem_mul_eq_self he hpR.1
  have hpf : p * f = p := IsGreenLeftDvd.mul_idem_eq_self hf hpL.2
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ := IsGreenRightDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem he hpR.2
  obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂⟩ := IsGreenLeftDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem hf hpL.1
  refine ⟨p, f * q₁ * e, ?_, ?_, hep, hpf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hpf, ← hq₁, he.eq]
  · calc f * q₁ * e * p = f * (q₁ * p) := by rw [mul_assoc, hep, mul_assoc]
      _ = q₂ * p * (q₁ * p) := by rw [← hq₂]
      _ = q₂ * (p * q₁) * p := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = q₂ * e * p := by rw [← hq₁]
      _ = q₂ * p := by rw [mul_assoc, hep]
      _ = f := hq₂.symm
  · rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hf.eq]
  · rw [mul_assoc, he.eq]

name: IsGreenH.conj_mem
statement:
theorem IsGreenH.conj_mem {e f p q : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hpq : p * q = e) (hqp : q * p = f)
    (hpf : p * f = p) (hfq : f * q = q) (hqe : q * e = q)
    {x : S} (hx : x 𝓗 e) : q * x * p 𝓗 f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', hx', hxx', hx'x⟩ := IsGreenH.exists_inv he hx
  have hxe : x * e = x := IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self he hx
  have hx'e : x' * e = x' := IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self he hx'
  
  have hmid : ∀ a b : S, q * a * p * (q * b * p) = q * (a * e * b) * p := by
    intro a b
    calc q * a * p * (q * b * p) = q * a * (p * q) * b * p := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = q * (a * e * b) * p := by rw [hpq]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  
  have h1 : q * x * p * f = q * x * p := by rw [mul_assoc, hpf]
  have h2 : f * (q * x * p) = q * x * p := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hfq]
  
  have hA : q * x' * p * (q * x * p) = f := by rw [hmid, hx'e, hx'x, hqe, hqp]
  have hB : q * x * p * (q * x' * p) = f := by rw [hmid, hxe, hxx', hqe, hqp]
  exact ⟨⟨Or.inr ⟨q * x * p, h1.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨q * x' * p, hA.symm⟩⟩,
         ⟨Or.inr ⟨q * x * p, h2.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨q * x' * p, hB.symm⟩⟩⟩

name: exists_hClass_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_hClass_mulEquiv {e f : S} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hD : e 𝓓 f) :
    letI := he.hClassGroup
    letI := hf.hClassGroup
    Nonempty (IsGreenH.eqvClass e ≃* IsGreenH.eqvClass f)
proof:
:= by
  letI := he.hClassGroup
  letI := hf.hClassGroup
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, hqp, hep, hpf, hfq, hqe⟩ := hD.exists_linking_pair he hf
  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun x => ⟨q * x.1 * p, IsGreenH.conj_mem he hpq hqp hpf hfq hqe x.2⟩,
          fun y => ⟨p * y.1 * q, IsGreenH.conj_mem hf hqp hpq hqe hep hpf y.2⟩,
          fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change p * (q * x.1 * p) * q = x.1
    have hex : e * x.1 = x.1 := IsGreenH.mul_left_eq_self he x.2
    have hxe : x.1 * e = x.1 := IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self he x.2
    calc p * (q * x.1 * p) * q = p * q * x.1 * (p * q) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = x.1 := by rw [hpq, hex, hxe]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change q * (p * y.1 * q) * p = y.1
    have hfy : f * y.1 = y.1 := IsGreenH.mul_left_eq_self hf y.2
    have hyf : y.1 * f = y.1 := IsGreenH.mul_right_eq_self hf y.2
    calc q * (p * y.1 * q) * p = q * p * y.1 * (q * p) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = y.1 := by rw [hqp, hfy, hyf]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change q * (x.1 * y.1) * p = q * x.1 * p * (q * y.1 * p)
    have hey : e * y.1 = y.1 := IsGreenH.mul_left_eq_self he y.2
    calc q * (x.1 * y.1) * p = q * (x.1 * (e * y.1)) * p := by rw [hey]
      _ = q * x.1 * p * (q * y.1 * p) := by
          symm
          calc q * x.1 * p * (q * y.1 * p) = q * (x.1 * (p * q * y.1)) * p := by
                simp only [mul_assoc]
            _ = q * (x.1 * (e * y.1)) * p := by rw [hpq]

name: Monoid.exists_idem_pow_aux
statement:
lemma exists_idem_pow_aux (x : M) (a e : ℕ)
    (h : x ^ (a + (e + 1)) = x ^ a) :
    ∃ k : ℕ+, x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have per : ∀ c t : ℕ, x ^ (a + c + t * (e + 1)) = x ^ (a + c) := by
    intro c t
    induction t with
    | zero => simp
    | succ t ih =>
      have e1 : a + c + (t + 1) * (e + 1) = a + (e + 1) + (c + t * (e + 1)) := by ring
      have e2 : a + (c + t * (e + 1)) = a + c + t * (e + 1) := by ring
      rw [e1, pow_add, h, ← pow_add, e2, ih]
  refine ⟨⟨(a + 1) * (e + 1), Nat.mul_pos a.succ_pos e.succ_pos⟩, ?_⟩
  change x ^ ((a + 1) * (e + 1)) * x ^ ((a + 1) * (e + 1)) = x ^ ((a + 1) * (e + 1))
  have key := per (a * e + e + 1) (a + 1)
  have e3 : a + (a * e + e + 1) = (a + 1) * (e + 1) := by ring
  rw [e3] at key
  rw [← pow_add]
  exact key

name: Monoid.distinct_powers_or_idempotent_pow
statement:
theorem distinct_powers_or_idempotent_pow (x : M) :
    (∀ i j : ℕ+, i ≠ j → x ^ (i : ℕ) ≠ x ^ (j : ℕ)) ∨
    (∃ k : ℕ+, x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ i j : ℕ+, i ≠ j → x ^ (i : ℕ) ≠ x ^ (j : ℕ)
  · exact Or.inl h
  right
  push Not at h
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := h
  have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hij
  rcases hne.lt_or_gt with hgt | hlt
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + (e + 1) :=
      ⟨(j : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩
    exact exists_idem_pow_aux x (i : ℕ) e (by rw [← he]; exact heq.symm)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, (i : ℕ) = (j : ℕ) + (e + 1) :=
      ⟨(i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩
    exact exists_idem_pow_aux x (j : ℕ) e (by rw [← he]; exact heq)

name: Monoid.forall_isUnit_or_exists_idempotent_pow_ne_one
statement:
theorem forall_isUnit_or_exists_idempotent_pow_ne_one [Finite M] :
    (∀ x : M, IsUnit x) ∨
      ∃ (x : M) (k : ℕ+), x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ) ∧ x ^ (k : ℕ) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x : M, ∃ k : ℕ+, x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ) := by
    intro x
    rcases distinct_powers_or_idempotent_pow x with hd | hi
    · exfalso
      have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : ℕ+ => x ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
        intro i j hij
        by_contra hne
        exact hd i j hne hij
      exact not_injective_infinite_finite _ hinj
    · exact hi
  by_cases h : ∃ (x : M) (k : ℕ+), x ^ (k : ℕ) * x ^ (k : ℕ) = x ^ (k : ℕ) ∧ x ^ (k : ℕ) ≠ 1
  · exact Or.inr h
  · left
    push Not at h
    intro x
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := key x
    have h1 : x ^ (k : ℕ) = 1 := h x k hk
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, (k : ℕ) = m + 1 := ⟨(k : ℕ) - 1, by have := k.pos; omega⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, x ^ m,
      by rw [← pow_succ', ← hm]; exact h1,
      by rw [← pow_succ, ← hm]; exact h1⟩, rfl⟩

name: IsGreenH.eqvClass_isSubgroupWith

   fun _ hx _ hy => mul_mem he hx hy,
   fun _ hx => ⟨mul_left_eq_self he hx, mul_right_eq_self he hx⟩,
   fun x hx => by obtain ⟨y, hy, h1, h2⟩ := exists_inv he hx; exact ⟨y, hy, h1, h2⟩⟩

    G ⊆ IsGreenH.eqvClass e

  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨g', -, hgg', hg'g⟩ := hinv g hg
  obtain ⟨hgl, hgr⟩ := hid g hg
  exact ⟨⟨Or.inr ⟨g, hgr.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨g', hg'g.symm⟩⟩,
         ⟨Or.inr ⟨g, hgl.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨g', hgg'.symm⟩⟩⟩

name: IsGreenH.eqvClass_isSubgroupWith_iff_exists_idempotent

theorem forall_isUnit_or_exists_maximal_subgroup {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [Finite M] :

        IsGreatest {G : Set M | IsSubgroupWith e G} (IsGreenH.eqvClass e)

  · exact Or.inr ⟨x ^ (k : ℕ), hk, hne, IsGreenH.eqvClass_isGreatest hk⟩

name: IsGreenH.mul_mem
statement:
theorem mul_mem (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (hx : x 𝓗 e) (hy : y 𝓗 e) :
    x * y 𝓗 e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h1 : x * y 𝓛 e * y := IsGreenL.mul_right y hx.1
    rw [mul_left_eq_self he hy] at h1
    exact h1.trans hy.1
  · have h2 : x * y 𝓡 x * e := IsGreenR.mul_left x hy.2
    rw [mul_right_eq_self he hx] at h2
    exact h2.trans hx.2

name: IsGreenH.exists_inv
statement:
theorem exists_inv (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (hx : x 𝓗 e) :
    ∃ y, y 𝓗 e ∧ x * y = e ∧ y * x = e
proof:
:= by
  have hex : e * x = x := mul_left_eq_self he hx
  have hxe : x * e = x := mul_right_eq_self he hx
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsGreenLeftDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem he hx.1.2
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := IsGreenRightDvd.exists_eq_mul_of_idem he hx.2.2
  have hyx : e * u * e * x = e := by
    rw [mul_assoc (e * u), hex, mul_assoc, ← hu, he.eq]
  have hxy' : x * (e * v * e) = e := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hxe, ← hv, he.eq]
  have h0 : e * u * e * e = e * u * e := by rw [mul_assoc (e * u), he.eq]
  have hyy' : e * u * e = e * v * e :=
    calc e * u * e = e * u * e * e := h0.symm
    _ = e * u * e * (x * (e * v * e)) := by rw [hxy']
    _ = e * u * e * x * (e * v * e) := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = e * (e * v * e) := by rw [hyx]
    _ = e * v * e := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he.eq]
  have hxy : x * (e * u * e) = e := by rw [hyy']; exact hxy'
  refine ⟨e * u * e, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, hxy, hyx⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨e * u, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hxy.symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨u * e, by rw [mul_assoc]⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hyx.symm⟩

    · exact ⟨(c : WithOne S), WithOne.coe_mul c b⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    cases c with
    | one => rw [one_mul] at hc; exact Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast hc)

    · exact ⟨1, (mul_one _).symm⟩
    · exact ⟨(c : WithOne S), WithOne.coe_mul b c⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    cases c with

:= by

  · rintro (rfl | ⟨u, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, v, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨1, 1, by rw [one_mul, mul_one]⟩
    · exact ⟨(u : WithOne S), 1, by rw [mul_one, WithOne.coe_mul]⟩
    · exact ⟨1, (v : WithOne S), by rw [one_mul, WithOne.coe_mul]⟩
    · exact ⟨(u : WithOne S), (v : WithOne S), by rw [WithOne.coe_mul, WithOne.coe_mul]⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, v, huv⟩
    cases u with
    | one =>
      rw [one_mul] at huv
      cases v with
      | one => rw [mul_one] at huv; exact IsGreenJRel.of_eq (by exact_mod_cast huv)
      | coe z => exact IsGreenJRel.mul_right z (by exact_mod_cast huv)
    | coe w =>
      cases v with
      | one => rw [mul_one] at huv; exact IsGreenJRel.mul_left w (by exact_mod_cast huv)
      | coe z => exact IsGreenJRel.mul_both w z (by exact_mod_cast huv)

name: IsZeroMinimalRightIdeal.image_mul_left
proof:
:= by
  have hAideal : IsRightIdeal ((a * ·) '' R) := by
    refine ⟨hR.isRightIdeal.1.image _, ?_⟩
    rintro x ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ s
    exact ⟨r * s, hR.isRightIdeal.2 r hr s, (mul_assoc a r s).symm⟩
  by_cases hbot : (a * ·) '' R = {0}
  · exact Or.inl hbot
  refine Or.inr ⟨hAideal, hbot, ?_⟩
  intro T hT hTA
  
  have hBideal : IsRightIdeal ({r ∈ R | a * r ∈ T} ∪ {0}) := by
    refine ⟨⟨0, Or.inr rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro r (⟨hrR, hrT⟩ | rfl) s
    · refine Or.inl ⟨hR.isRightIdeal.2 r hrR s, ?_⟩
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact hT.2 _ hrT s
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (zero_mul s))
  have hBsub : {r ∈ R | a * r ∈ T} ∪ {0} ⊆ R := by
    rintro r (⟨hrR, _⟩ | rfl)
    · exact hrR
    · exact hR.isRightIdeal.zero_mem
  rcases hR.eq_bot_or_eq _ hBideal hBsub with hB | hB
  · 
    left
    refine Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨hT.zero_mem, fun t htT => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hrR, rfl⟩ := hTA htT
    have hrB : r ∈ {r ∈ R | a * r ∈ T} ∪ {0} := Or.inl ⟨hrR, htT⟩
    rw [hB] at hrB
    simp [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hrB]
  · 
    right
    refine Set.Subset.antisymm hTA ?_
    rintro x ⟨r, hrR, rfl⟩
    have hrB : r ∈ {r ∈ R | a * r ∈ T} ∪ {0} := by rw [hB]; exact hrR
    rcases hrB with ⟨_, hrT⟩ | rfl
    · exact hrT
    · simpa using hT.zero_mem

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_mul_eq_of_idem_mul
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_mul_eq_of_idem_mul (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {e : S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hea : e * a = a) : ∃ w : S, a * w = e
proof:
:= by
  have hee := he.isIdempotentElem.eq
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_eq_mul_mul ha e
  
  set f := a * v * e * u with hf
  have hff : IsIdempotentElem f := by
    change f * f = f
    calc f * f = a * v * (e * (u * a * v) * e) * u := by simp only [hf, mul_assoc]
      _ = a * v * (e * e * e) * u := by rw [← huv]
      _ = f := by rw [hee, hee, hf]
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have key : u * f * (a * v) = e := by
      calc u * f * (a * v) = u * a * v * e * (u * a * v) := by
            rw [hf]; simp only [mul_assoc]
        _ = e := by rw [← huv, hee, hee]
    rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_mul] at key
    exact he.ne_zero key.symm
  have hef : e * f = f := by
    rw [hf, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hea]
  
  have hfe0 : f * e ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hf0
    calc f = f * f := hff.eq.symm
      _ = f * (e * f) := by rw [hef]
      _ = f * e * f := (mul_assoc f e f).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [h0, zero_mul]
  have hfe_idem : IsIdempotentElem (f * e) := by
    change f * e * (f * e) = f * e
    calc f * e * (f * e) = f * (e * f) * e := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = f * f * e := by rw [hef]
      _ = f * e := by rw [hff.eq]
  
  have hkey : f * e = e :=
    he.eq_of_le (f * e) hfe_idem hfe0 (by rw [← mul_assoc, hef])
      (by rw [mul_assoc, hee])
  refine ⟨v * e * u * e, ?_⟩
  calc a * (v * e * u * e) = f * e := by rw [hf]; simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = e := hkey

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_mul_eq_of_mul_idem
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.exists_mul_eq_of_mul_idem (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {e : S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hae : a * e = a) : ∃ w : S, w * a = e
proof:
:= by
  have hee := he.isIdempotentElem.eq
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_eq_mul_mul ha e
  
  set g := v * e * u * a with hg
  have hgg : IsIdempotentElem g := by
    change g * g = g
    calc g * g = v * (e * (u * a * v) * e) * (u * a) := by simp only [hg, mul_assoc]
      _ = v * (e * e * e) * (u * a) := by rw [← huv]
      _ = v * e * (u * a) := by rw [hee, hee]
      _ = g := by rw [hg]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have key : u * a * g * v = e := by
      calc u * a * g * v = u * a * v * e * (u * a * v) := by
            rw [hg]; simp only [mul_assoc]
        _ = e := by rw [← huv, hee, hee]
    rw [h0, mul_zero, zero_mul] at key
    exact he.ne_zero key.symm
  have hge : g * e = g := by rw [hg, mul_assoc, hae]
  
  have heg0 : e * g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hg0
    calc g = g * g := hgg.eq.symm
      _ = g * e * g := by rw [hge]
      _ = g * (e * g) := mul_assoc g e g
      _ = 0 := by rw [h0, mul_zero]
  have heg_idem : IsIdempotentElem (e * g) := by
    change e * g * (e * g) = e * g
    calc e * g * (e * g) = e * (g * e * g) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = e * (g * g) := by rw [hge]
      _ = e * g := by rw [hgg.eq]
  
  have hkey : e * g = e :=
    he.eq_of_le (e * g) heg_idem heg0 (by rw [← mul_assoc, hee])
      (by rw [mul_assoc, hge])
  refine ⟨e * v * e * u, ?_⟩
  calc e * v * e * u * a = e * g := by rw [hg]; simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = e := hkey

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isGreenR_of_idem_mul
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isGreenR_of_idem_mul (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {e : S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {a : S} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hea : e * a = a) : a 𝓡 e
proof:
:=
  let ⟨w, hw⟩ := he.exists_mul_eq_of_idem_mul hS ha hea
  ⟨Or.inr ⟨a, hea.symm⟩, Or.inr ⟨w, hw.symm⟩⟩

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isZeroMinimalRightIdeal
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isZeroMinimalRightIdeal (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {e : S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) :
    IsZeroMinimalRightIdeal (principalRightIdealSet e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isRightIdeal_principalRightIdealSet e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hmem := mem_principalRightIdealSet_self e
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact he.ne_zero (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem)
  · intro T hT hTsub
    by_cases hT0 : T = {0}
    · exact Or.inl hT0
    right
    obtain ⟨a, haT, ha0⟩ := exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hT.zero_mem hT0
    have hea : e * a = a :=
      IsGreenRightDvd.idem_mul_eq_self he.isIdempotentElem (hTsub haT)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := he.exists_mul_eq_of_idem_mul hS ha0 hea
    have heT : e ∈ T := by
      rw [← hw]
      exact hT.2 a haT w
    exact Set.Subset.antisymm hTsub (hT.principalRightIdealSet_subset heT)

name: IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isGreenD_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsPrimitiveIdempotent.isGreenD_of_ne_zero (hS : IsZeroSimple S)
    {e : S} (he : IsPrimitiveIdempotent e) {x : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x 𝓓 e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hS.exists_eq_mul_mul he.ne_zero x
  have hev0 : e * v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hx (by rw [huv, mul_assoc, h0, mul_zero])
  
  have hR : e * v 𝓡 e :=
    he.isGreenR_of_idem_mul hS hev0 (by rw [← mul_assoc, he.isIdempotentElem.eq])
  
  have hxA : x ∈ (· * v) '' principalLeftIdealSet e :=
    ⟨u * e, Or.inr ⟨u, rfl⟩, huv.symm⟩
  have hAmin : IsZeroMinimalLeftIdeal ((· * v) '' principalLeftIdealSet e) := by
    rcases (he.isZeroMinimalLeftIdeal hS).image_mul_right v with h | h
    · rw [h] at hxA
      exact absurd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hxA) hx
    · exact h
  have hPx : principalLeftIdealSet x = (· * v) '' principalLeftIdealSet e := by
    rcases hAmin.eq_bot_or_eq _ (isLeftIdeal_principalLeftIdealSet x)
        (hAmin.isLeftIdeal.principalLeftIdealSet_subset hxA) with h | h
    · have hself := mem_principalLeftIdealSet_self x
      rw [h] at hself
      exact absurd (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hself) hx
    · exact h
  have hev_mem : e * v ∈ principalLeftIdealSet x := by
    rw [hPx]
    exact ⟨e, mem_principalLeftIdealSet_self e, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨e * v, ⟨Or.inr ⟨u, by rw [huv, mul_assoc]⟩, hev_mem⟩, hR⟩

name: IsCompletelyZeroSimple.isGreenD_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsCompletelyZeroSimple.isGreenD_of_ne_zero (hS : IsCompletelyZeroSimple S)
    {x y : S} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x 𝓓 y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hS.exists_primitive
  exact IsGreenD.trans (he.isGreenD_of_ne_zero hS.isZeroSimple hx)
    (IsGreenD.symm (he.isGreenD_of_ne_zero hS.isZeroSimple hy))
